# Lineach — Mechanical Piping & Welding Contractors, Ireland

Lineach (Lineach Construction Limited) is an Irish mechanical contracting company specialising in process piping, utility piping, high-purity piping, and certified welding for the pharmaceutical, food & beverage, oil & gas, refining, and manufacturing sectors.

## Core Expertise
- End-to-end process, utility, instrument, and high-purity piping systems
- Turnkey design, fabrication, spooling, installation, testing, and commissioning
- Materials: Carbon Steel, Stainless Steel (316L), Duplex/Super Duplex, Inconel, Titanium, Hastelloy, Copper Nickel
- Welding: TIG, MIG, SMAW, Submerged Arc, Flux-Core, Open Root. All welders dual-certified ASME IX and EN287 (ISO 9606)
- In-house WPQR/WPS management, full material traceability, pressure testing, NDT coordination
- Hot taps, tie-ins, in-service repairs, and shutdown support
- High-purity orbital welding with inert gas purge, cleanroom standards, and full documentation packs

## Locations
- Head office / base: Ardnamullan, Clonard, Co Meath, Ireland
- Service area: Nationwide Ireland (Dublin, Cork, Waterford, Limerick, Shannon, Galway and beyond) plus select European projects
